normal.name: スパックマン クリス
normal.text: working on a new game. don't have a good name for it yet, but it is based on a 'stop the asteroid' novel i have had on the back burner for several years. The alien scout ship discovers the asteroid while on their way out of our solar system. Can they prevent an ELE on Earth without the humans noticing? Should they warn the humans? Can they warn without revealing themselves? How do you get the attention of, and a meet w/, world leaders w/o anyone noticing? #writing #gaming #SciFi #HardSciFi

normal.name: Marcus Adams
normal.text: So playing flat content in "theater mode" in #VR space with the #SteamFrame? Actually really cool. It gives you a massive virtual display with mood lighting around and behind it that changes in real time to match the content being viewed. I used the dongle to stream some Oblivion Remastered from our main desktop gaming PC, as I'm pretty sure the Frame would explode if it tried to run that game locally, and it was a solid, enjoyable experience. 1/? #Gaming #PCGaming

heated.name: Judeau (EatTheRich)
heated.text: In other big announcements that happened on November 3rd, my #steamcontroller came in. I didn't mention it yesterday because I didn't want to overshadow all of the political winnings with my news. There were a lot of updates before I could use it. My #steamdeck had several updates, and then the puck had to be updated, and then the controller had to be updated but once all of that was sorted it paired and worked great. I will say that the track pads don't feel quite as nice as the ones built into the steam deck itself, but they're still fantastic and usable.
heated.media: image: A picture of the steam controller box. The words at your fingertips can be read on the front of it and the steam deck controller is just below it.
